findingDetails.title: Target packet lacks normative review inputs
findingDetails.claim: The declared spec-folder target has no spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md, or checklist.md, so the core spec and checklist protocols cannot establish evidence.
findingDetails.evidence: The target root contains review-report.md but no normative packet files.
findingDetails.recommendation: Create and reconcile the target packet spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md, and checklist.md before treating the core traceability gates as complete.

findingDetails.title: Shared plugin contract omits six newly covered plugins in its overview and relation note
